battle.name: 唐與契丹、奚等之戰
battle.brief: 顯慶五年，唐分冷岍、沙磧兩道出師，討叛奚與契丹。營州都督府節制北邊內藩，奚在饒樂、契丹在松漠，兩道行軍總管各率所部北進。羅馬弩砲那種一發一具箭的扭力重弩，唐軍並無同型裝備，但它在戰役中的角色由床弩與配重擲車接替：用來打穿寨柵、拒馬與密集的騎步行列。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰的一方是唐王朝的東北邊軍體系，另一方是唐的內藩契丹與奚。契丹居松漠都督府，奚居饒樂都督府，兩者皆受唐冊封都督、互市賜袍，是唐在幽州都督府與營州都督府兼東夷都護府之下羈縻編制的部族。唐廷對他們的關係靠首領與部眾雙重維繫：部眾可作為附庸騎兵隨唐征高句麗、百濟，首領也隨時因安置、差發與邊吏的處置而叛。顯慶五年叛起後，唐不派大軍直取其地，而是分道討討：以定襄都督阿史德樞賓、左武候將軍延陀梯真、居延州都督李合珠並為冷岍道行軍總管，各將所部兵討叛奚；命尚書右丞崔餘慶充使總護三部兵，兼監護三道的協同與受降交涉。奚部隨即遣使降；其後唐改以樞賓等為沙磧道行軍總管討契丹，擒契丹松漠都督阿卜固，械送東都洛陽。戰線自營州向北推進至冷岍道所指的奚地與沙磧道所指的松漠沙地，縱深數百里，屬草原—邊地的機動作戰，糧秣全靠幽、營二州的倉廩、屯田與車隊維持，無法長期壓迫遠方都督府。
countriesEn: One side was the Tang dynasty's north-eastern frontier apparatus, the other the Tang vassal peoples of the Khitan and the Xi. The Khitan held the Songmo Military Prefecture and the Xi the Raole Military Prefecture; both were tied to the court by ennobled governors, tribute and barter, and both sat inside the jimi administrative system under the Youzhou military governorship and the Yingzhou military governorship, which also served as the East Barbarian Protectorate. Tang control rested on chiefs and warriors alike: the same tribal horsemen could serve as auxiliaries in campaigns against Goguryeo and Baekje, yet a chief could also revolt over resettlement, levies or the conduct of Tang border officials. When the rising began in Xuanqing 5, the court did not march a great army into the tribal lands. It split the pursuit into two circuits. Ashede Shubin, military governor of Dingxiang, Zuotuo Dizhen, officer of the Left Wuhou Guard, and Li Hezhong, military governor of Yuzhou, were all appointed joint zongguan of the Lengjian Circuit, each to lead his own troops against the revolting Xi, while Cui Yuqing, right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was sent as commissioner to supervise the three columns and to handle the surrender. The Xi promptly sent envoys and surrendered. The same commanders were then made zongguan of the Shaxi Circuit against the Khitan, and they took the Songmo governor Abu Gu, who was sent under escort to the eastern capital at Luoyang. The line of operations ran north from Yingzhou through the Xi country indicated by the Lengjian Circuit and the sands of Songmo indicated by the Shaxi Circuit, several hundred li deep. It was a mobile grassland and frontier operation, and the army lived on the depots and tuntian of You and Ying with baggage trains, unable to press permanently toward a distant prefecture.
people: 唐一線主導此役者是三名以蕃部與邊州為部的將領：定襄都督阿史德樞賓，鐵勒系的歸唐宿將，被任命為冷岍道行軍總管，主責討叛奚；左武候將軍延陀梯真，內附的鐵勒領袖，與樞賓、李合珠同為三道總管之一；居延州都督李合珠，出河西邊鎮，掌朔方以西的部眾。尚書右丞崔餘慶奉詔充使總護三部兵，其角色不是前鋒，而是中樞的監護者，負責三道兵的調度、糧秣分配與受降談判，也防止任何一位總管同時兼領兩道而失控。契丹方面的主角是松漠都督阿卜固，他被擒後送洛陽，是唐與契丹羈縻關係的關鍵人物；史載只及此一人姓名，奚、契丹的其他首領諸說並存，多不可考。營州方向則由營州都督兼東夷都護程名振與右領軍中郎將薛仁貴主持：同年六月，兩人率軍攻高麗赤烽鎮，拔之，斬首四百餘級、捕虜百餘人，高麗大將豆方婁率眾三萬拒戰，被以契丹兵為先鋒的逆擊打崩，斬首二千五百級。同一批契丹部眾在六月是唐軍的先鋒，五月卻是叛軍主力，這正是本役最值得玩味之處；同期唐軍在百濟與高句麗方向還有蘇定方、劉仁軌、劉仁願等水陸大將在用兵，與本役的東北邊戰並行消耗。
peopleEn: On the Tang side the operation was led by three commanders whose strength lay in tribal and frontier troops. Ashede Shubin, military governor of Dingxiang, a veteran of Tiele origin who had submitted to Tang, was appointed zongguan of the Lengjian Circuit and took responsibility for the rebellious Xi. Zuotuo Dizhen, an officer of the Left Wuhou Guard and a submitted Tiele leader, shared the appointment with Shubin and Li Hezhong, military governor of Yuzhou, a man drawn from the western frontier towns who commanded the tribes west of the Ordos. Cui Yuqing, right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was sent as commissioner to supervise the three columns. He was not a spearhead but the court's warden: he coordinated the columns, allocated grain and stores, handled the surrender, and kept any single commander from taking charge of two circuits at once and overreaching. The central figure on the Khitan side was Abu Gu, governor of Songmo, whose capture and removal to Luoyang marked the hinge of Tang-Khitan relations. Only this one name survives in the records; the names of other Khitan and Xi chiefs are the subject of competing claims and mostly cannot be established. On the Yingzhou side the business was handled by Cheng Mingzhen, military governor of Yingzhou and East Barbarian Protector, together with Xue Rengui, officer of the Right Army of the Guards. In the sixth month of the same year the two of them attacked the Goguryeo fort of Chifeng, took it, and counted more than four hundred heads cut off and over a hundred prisoners. Dou Fanglou, a Goguryeo general, came out with thirty thousand to oppose them and was broken by a charge led by Khitan auxiliaries, with twenty-five hundred heads taken. The same Khitan warriors were Tang auxiliaries in the sixth month and the core of the rebels in the fifth; that is the most striking feature of this campaign. Meanwhile Su Dingfang, Liu Zhengui and Liu Renyuan were running the sea and land campaigns against Baekje and Goguryeo, and the north-eastern frontier war drew on the same exhausted resources.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲是扭力儲能的單發重投射器：一次上緊只發一支粗重箭矢，射程與穿透力集中於一點，用途是拆城牆、破柵寨、壓制密集的步兵方陣，一發一具箭的特性使它適合在關鍵時刻專打一個目標，而非像弓弩那樣靠反覆速射形成覆蓋。唐朝東北邊防並無這種地中海式扭力重弩，它是希臘—羅馬工程技術的產物，東亞未見同型裝備；唐代在同一戰術功能上以唐軍自己的器械接替：可置於弩臺、橐駝車或城頭的床弩，臂弩與擘張弩，以及配重式的擲車、飛石車、發石車。營州至松漠前線的常備還包括明光鎧與札甲、馬具與具裝馬、連弩與火矢、櫓車、雲梯、望樓、旌旗金鼓、斥候馬，以及運載甲士、糧秣與器械的輜重車。兩道行軍總管所領的「所部兵」多為蕃部騎隊與邊州軍的混合，騎兵依賴隨軍馬匹與沿途屯田供給，冬季雪深草枯時難以深入，故戰事多在夏秋進行。攻城器械的具體數量與投射彈丸的消耗均無記載，不宜估算。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman scorpio, a torsion-powered single-shot heavy projector: wound once, it throws a single heavy bolt, concentrating range and penetration on one point, and it was used to break city walls, shatter palisades and batter dense infantry blocks. One shot, one bolt makes it a weapon for hitting one chosen target at a decisive moment rather than for laying down a curtain of fire the way a bow or a hand crossbow does. The Tang north-eastern frontier had no such Mediterranean torsion engine; it was a product of Greek and Roman engineering and had no counterpart in East Asia. Tang filled the same tactical role with its own machines: the bed crossbow that could be mounted on a platform, on a pack cart or on a parapet, the arm crossbow and the tension bow, and the counterweight trebuchet with its stone-throwing and fire-throwing variants. The standing inventory of the line from Yingzhou to Songmo also included bright armour and lamellar armour for infantry, harness and armoured horses, repeating crossbows and fire arrows, mantlets, siege ladders, watch towers, banners, drums and gongs, scout horses, and baggage carts for troops, grain and machines. The troops the two zongguan led, their own men, were mixed tribal cavalry and frontier garrison; the horse lines depended on animals carried with the column and on tuntian supply along the route, and deep winter snow and withered pasture made long pushes impossible, so the campaigning was done in summer and autumn. No record gives the number of siege machines or the quantity of projectiles expended, and no estimate should be attempted.
tactics: 此役的戰術骨架是分道討討與以夷制夷兩件事。第一是分道：唐不把兵力集中成一條攻線，而拆成冷岍道與沙磧道，冷岍道沿營州以北指向奚部所居的冷山一帶，先行壓進討平叛奚、迫其遣使降；再以沙磧道穿過松漠沙地直取契丹聚落，擒其松漠都督。三道兵各將所部、互不相援，中樞只以「使總護」派人監護，這是邊防作戰的現實選擇：本部兵只服本部將令，強行合兵反而易生疑貳。第二是投射與衝擊的配合：先以游騎、斥候探明部眾聚落、柵寨與水源，再擇地設營，圍而不急攻；用床弩、擲車、飛石這類投射器械壓制寨內與寨前的密集隊形、拆掉拒馬與鹿角，然後以騎兵衝擊寨外散兵或分兵截斷退路。第三是攻守形式上的克制：唐軍沒有在草原上建立常駐據點，沒有解散奚、契丹的部落編制，平叛之後即以改封、賜物、編戶收束，換取邊境安寧。第四是把部族兵放在最前的編制邏輯——同年六月赤蜂鎮之役正是以契丹兵為逆擊先鋒，擊潰高麗三萬眾；同一套部族兵，用在對外時是先鋒，用在內附時就是叛軍主力。糧秣線極長，自幽州、營州至松漠數百里，車隊與屯田決定了戰爭只能短打，不能久拖。至於具體陣形、衝鋒次序與設營法則，記載有限，諸說並存。
tacticsEn: The tactical frame of this campaign was made of two things: division into circuits, and the use of subject peoples against one another. First, division. Tang did not concentrate its strength on a single line of advance. It split the force into the Lengjian Circuit and the Shaxi Circuit. The Lengjian ran north from Yingzhou toward the cold mountains where the Xi were settled and pressed in first, breaking the revolt and forcing the Xi to send envoys and surrender; the Shaxi then crossed the sands of Songmo against the Khitan concentrations and took the Songmo governor. Each of the three columns led its own men and did not support the others, and the court only sent a commissioner to supervise them. That was the realistic choice for frontier work: tribal troops obey their own commanders, and forced amalgamation breeds suspicion faster than it produces strength. Second, the pairing of projection with charge. Mounted scouts first located the tribal settlements, their palisades and their water; the army then chose a camp site and invested rather than assaulted at once. Bed crossbows, trebuchets and stone-throwers were used to press the crowded formations inside and in front of the stockade and to break the chevaux-de-frise and the sharpened barriers, and only then did cavalry charge the loose men outside the gate, or columns were detached to cut the way of retreat. Third, restraint in form as well as in scale: the Tang established no permanent garrison on the grassland and dissolved no tribal organisation, and once the revolt was settled the matter was closed by re-enfeoffment, gifts and registration, in exchange for quiet on the frontier. Fourth, the placing of tribal troops at the head of the order of battle; in the Chifeng action of the same sixth month Khitan riders were the counter-charge that broke a Goguryeo army of thirty thousand. The same tribal soldiers were auxiliaries when facing outsiders and rebels when facing Tang. The supply line was very long, several hundred li from You and Ying to Songmo, and the baggage trains and tuntian decided that the war had to be fought short. Details of formations, order of advance and camp layout are poorly recorded and claims differ.
data: 時間：《資治通鑑》卷二百所繫，顯慶五年（公元六六〇年）五月戊辰下詔，以樞賓、梯真、合珠為冷岍道行軍總管討叛奚，崔餘慶充使總護三部兵，奚尋遣使降；旋改沙磧道討契丹，擒松漠都督阿卜固送東都。戰爭列表一系則把這場戰爭繫於同年八月，兩個月份或指同一輪邊事的詔令與戰事展開之先後，史無明文可斷其異同。地理距離：營州都督府治所在今遼寧朝陽一帶，東北向松漠都督府所在約數百里至千里量級，冷岍道與沙磧道都是穿越草原與沙地的道路，屬機動作戰而非攻城重兵對決。兵力：《資治通鑑》只作「各將所部兵」與「總護三部兵」之語，不載確數；三部兵的實際規模無從考定，也不可把「所部兵」當作唐的常備軍編制。可比數字來自同年六月赤烽鎮之役：拔赤烽鎮斬首四百餘級、捕虜百餘人；高麗大將豆方婁率眾三萬拒戰，被以契丹為先鋒的逆擊大破，斬首二千五百級。戰果：奚部遣使降，契丹松漠都督阿卜固被擒送洛陽。損耗：此役的唐軍傷亡、器械耗用與行程里數均無記載，諸說並存，不宜估算。
dataEn: Timing: the Zizhi Tongjian has the dispatch in the fifth month of Xuanqing 5 (AD 660), on the day wuchen, appointing Shubin, Dizhen and Hezhong as zongguan of the Lengjian Circuit against the rebellious Xi, with Cui Yuqing sent as commissioner to supervise the three columns; the Xi soon sent envoys and surrendered, and the command was then turned to the Shaxi Circuit against the Khitan, taking the Songmo governor Abu Gu and sending him to the eastern capital. The list of wars and related listings attaches this war to the eighth month of the same year; the two months may refer to the promulgation and the unfolding of the same round of frontier business, and the sources do not settle the question. Distance: the seat of the Yingzhou military governorship lies in the area of present-day Chaoyang in Liaoning, and the Songmo Military Prefecture lay several hundred li to a thousand li away to the north-east. Both circuits ran through grassland and sand roads, so this was mobile campaigning rather than a set-piece siege. Troop strength: the Tongjian says only that each commander led his own troops and that three columns were supervised, and gives no numbers; the actual size of the three columns cannot be established, and the phrase own troops must not be read as a regular Tang army establishment. Comparable figures come from the Chifeng action in the sixth month of the same year: more than four hundred heads cut off and over a hundred prisoners when the fort of Chifeng was taken, and Dou Fanglou of Goguryeo coming out with thirty thousand to be broken by a counter-charge led by Khitan, with twenty-five hundred heads taken. Results: the Xi sent envoys and surrendered; Abu Gu, governor of Songmo, was taken and sent to Luoyang. Losses: Tang casualties, machine consumption and miles marched are all unrecorded, claims differ, and no estimate should be offered.
cause: 直接起因是唐在東北同時對高句麗、百濟用兵，幽、營二州與河北、山東的兵源、馬匹、糧秣被大量抽調，邊防空虛，而契丹、奚在羈縻體制下承受的差發、互市折價與安置壓力積累到無法化解，於顯慶五年先後叛起。制度層面的原因更長：唐自貞觀以來對契丹、奚採羈縻都督府之制，授官、賜袍、編戶、互市，隔年一度，兩族首領的地位靠唐廷的冊授維持；但首領與部眾之間、以及首領與唐廷之間都沒有強力的第三方約束，一旦朝廷更換都督、停給或改置牧地，首領的權威就會被自己的部眾取代，叛亂隨即發生。同一年裡部族自身也有生計壓力：契丹、奚以畜牧為業，草原的寒暑與牲畜疫病直接決定族群能否存活，邊市一旦關閉或饑饉到來，劫掠式的叛亂就成為最自然的出路。更深一層的背景是六十餘年來對高句麗、百濟的持久戰爭：唐廷在 645 年出兵、658 年滅百濟、660 年前後仍在東北用兵，兵力的抽調正是把邊防空虛直接造出來的動作。還有第三層：同年六月，契丹部眾被唐軍徵為赤烽鎮之戰的先鋒而打崩高麗三萬眾，這種「以夷制夷」的高強度動用，破壞了部眾對唐的信任，也讓唐廷自己先展示了內藩的軍事價值。
causeEn: The immediate cause is that Tang was fighting Goguryeo and Baekje in the north-east at the same time, so the manpower, horses and grain of You, Ying and the Hebei and Shandong districts were heavily drawn away and the frontier was left thin, while the pressure of levies, barter terms and resettlement on the Khitan and the Xi under the jimi system built up to the point of no return, and the two peoples rose in the course of Xuanqing 5. The institutional cause runs deeper. Since Zhenguan the Tang had governed the Khitan and the Xi through jimi military prefectures: appointment, robes, registration and barter, held at intervals of a year or so, and the standing of each chief rested on what the court granted him. Yet neither a chief and his people nor a chief and the court had any third party to restrain them, so the moment the court replaced a governor, withheld the grants or moved the pastures, a chief's authority was supplanted by that of his own warriors and revolt followed. The tribes also carried their own livelihood stress in the same year: the Khitan and the Xi lived on herding, and the grassland climate and livestock disease decided directly whether a group could survive, so once the border markets closed or famine came, a predatory revolt was the most natural road. Behind everything lies more than sixty years of continuous war against Goguryeo and Baekje: the court campaigned from 645, destroyed Baekje in 658 and was still fighting in the north-east around 660, and it was those mobilisations that hollowed out the frontier. There is a third layer as well. In the sixth month of the same year Khitan warriors were conscripted as the vanguard of the Tang army at Chifeng and broke a Goguryeo host of thirty thousand; the intensive use of subject peoples in this way damaged trust on the tribal side, and at the same time the court had just demonstrated the military value of its Inner Vassals.
impact: 短期看，此役的結果是唐廷重新取得對松漠、饒樂兩處都督府的直接介入權：叛奚降、契丹松漠都督阿卜固被擒送洛陽，冷岍道與沙磧道這兩條北進通道重新被寫進唐的邊防敘事，而被安置在幽、營二州的降附部眾成為唐軍馬匹與附庸兵的主要來源之一，唐對內藩的羈縻控制也隨之收緊。中期看，唐廷此後更倚重北方蕃兵與降將，甚至把契丹、奚首領視作「藩屏」，同時又把兵權與安輯責任下放給蕃將，這正是契丹得以坐大的制度條件：同一套安排既壓榨部眾，又授權首領。多年後神龍元年（705）契丹李盡忠、孫萬榮反唐，與顯慶五年的羈縻安排一脈相承。長期看，唐末以來契丹逐步統一草原，先後兼併奚與室韋，建立起北方的契丹國家；唐的衰亡與契丹的崛起在同一個世紀內完成，而宋以後的北方格局由此奠定。從裝備與戰術角度，此役還反覆證明一點：在缺乏攻城重兵與長久補給能力的邊防線上，唐廷寧取「討平即撤、以羈縻收束」的短期兌換，不願為一片草原投入持久的攻城器械與糧道。
impactEn: In the short term the campaign restored the court's direct hold over the two prefectures of Songmo and Raole: the Xi were reduced to submission, the Khitan governor of Songmo, Abu Gu, was taken to Luoyang, and the two northward roads, the Lengjian and the Shaxi, were written back into Tang's frontier geography. The surrendered and resettled tribal people settled at You and Ying became one of the main sources of horses and of auxiliary troops for the Tang army, and control over the Inner Vassals was tightened. In the medium term the court leaned harder on northern tribal soldiers and on surrendered commanders, treating Khitan and Xi chiefs as screens for the realm while at the same time handing them command and the duty of pacification. That combination was the institutional condition for Khitan growth: the same arrangement that weighed on the tribes also empowered their chiefs. The Khitan revolt of Li Jinzhong and Sun Wanrong in the first year of Shenlong (705) grew directly out of the jimi arrangements of Xuanqing 5. In the long run the Khitan gradually united the grassland, absorbed the Xi and the Shiwei, and built a Khitan state in the north; the fall of the Tang and the rise of the Khitan were completed within the same century, and the northern order of the Song and later dynasties was set by it. On the material side the campaign also demonstrated a point again and again: on a frontier line without siege trains or long-range supply, the Tang court preferred the short exchange of subduing and withdrawing, settling matters through jimi arrangements, and would not commit heavy machines and long supply lines to hold open grassland.
result: 唐軍在顯慶五年夏秋之間分道討平叛奚、討伐契丹，結果是奚部遣使降、契丹松漠都督阿卜固被擒並械送東都，唐廷重新取得對饒樂、松漠兩處都督府的介入權。但這不是摧毀性的勝利：唐軍並未深入草原建立常駐據點，沒有解散奚、契丹的部落編制，也沒有改變羈縻的基本形式，戰線在奏捷之後即告收縮。契丹與奚的首領體系被削弱而未被打斷，阿卜固之下松漠與饒樂的內部權力結構照舊存在，奚部降而未散，仍留在原地。戰役的實際結果是「以有限代價恢復舊秩序」：唐用樞賓、梯真、合珠三部兵與營、幽二州的邊軍完成任務，付出的是邊軍的疲敝與河北一線的兵役負擔，換回數年的邊境安寧。三部兵與唐邊軍的具體傷亡、器械耗損與行程里數史無缺載，不宜估算；而在評估此役時最需要留意的一點是，此戰之後不到半世紀，契丹再度南下時的實力已遠非顯慶五年可比：正是這場戰役之後的羈縻安排、正是唐廷把邊防責任下放給蕃將的做法，把契丹推上了北方的位置。
resultEn: Between the summer and autumn of Xuanqing 5 the Tang army settled the revolt of the Xi and campaigned against the Khitan along two separate circuits, and the outcome was that the Xi sent envoys and submitted, the Khitan governor of Songmo, Abu Gu, was taken and escorted to the eastern capital, and the court regained its footing in the two prefectures of Raole and Songmo. It was not a destructive victory. The army did not push deep into the grassland to set up permanent garrisons, did not dissolve the tribal organisations of the Xi and the Khitan, and did not change the basic form of the jimi system; the line of operations contracted as soon as the victory was reported. The chiefdoms of the Khitan and the Xi were weakened but not broken: under Abu Gu the internal structure of authority in Songmo and Raole continued to exist, and the Xi submitted without dispersing and stayed where they were. The real result was the restoration of the old order at limited cost: Tang finished the work with the three columns of Shubin, Dizhen and Hezhong and with the frontier troops of Ying and You, paying in the exhaustion of the frontier soldiers and in the burden of conscription along the Hebei line, and buying several years of quiet on the frontier. The specific casualties among the three columns and the Tang frontier troops, the consumption of machines and the miles covered are simply not recorded, and no estimate should be offered. The point that matters most when weighing this campaign is that within less than half a century, when the Khitan invaded again, their strength was nothing like what it had been in Xuanqing 5: it was the jimi arrangements concluded after this war, and above all the Tang practice of handing frontier responsibility to tribal commanders, that pushed the Khitan into the place they would occupy in the north.
